checks: Real Git applies all six exact files with raw bytes; local configuration and the real parent repository index remain unchanged
Applying the same patch again is idempotent and leaves files unchanged
A customer source edit refuses the whole patch before private metadata or destinations are written
A traversal destination is rejected and the outside sentinel is preserved
A changed patch checksum refuses all destination writes
The real preflight accepts available ports, releases every probe and preserves the existing configuration
The real preflight refuses an occupied database port while preserving its listening owner
The patched bootstrap refuses the conflict before runtime preparation, dependency installation or configuration writes
Every new root and bilingual-guide local link resolves to a real frozen or patched archive entry
scope: Nine real patch/CLI checks; owned synthetic file fixtures and loopback probes only. No dependency install, database, browser, model or broad regression.
